mapper.select: select a.*, b.SECOND_LEVEL as mainContractSecondLevel,b.PROJECT_NAME as mainContractName,b.CONTRACT_AMOUNT as mainContractAmount from BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT a left join BIZ_CRM_HETONG b on (a.HETONG_ID = b.ID or (a.MAIN_CONTRACT_NO = b.CONTRACT_NO and b.CONTRACT_NO !='' and b.CONTRACT_NO IS NOT NULL)) and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' where a.ID = ${id}
select * from BIZ_CRM_SUBCONTRACT where HETONG_ID = ${hetongId} and DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE'
